description: Enhanced edge coverage for compact-token segment extraction, disjoint from the native suite: a four-part token (too many segments -> invalid -> empty object), a two-part token (too few segments -> invalid -> empty object), a structurally valid three-part token with an empty trailing signature segment (raw extraction yields an empty string), base64url-decoding a real JOSE header object, base64url-decoding a payload with multi-byte UTF-8 content (accented letters, a star glyph) so non-ASCII round-trips, and decoding a payload whose JSON carries a numeric and a boolean value.
